supplemental_test_patch_scope: Retained as a replayable diagnostic addition against the frozen measured source. Current installed product and test inputs remain unchanged.
findings: Adding 100 top-level workspace files to the existing 3500-repeat Unicode artifact-input flow crosses the native automatic-compaction threshold. The original single-response provider fixture answers the summary request and closes its listener before the main generation.

The retained failed fixture journal records a committed compaction and a later provider HTTP connection failure. The observed DurabilityUnknown is not evidence that the workspace listing corrupted storage; the test had omitted the main generation response.

With two scripted responses, the summary request and the main grounded request complete, the full original user text is recovered page by page, a fork creates a distinct scope, and the operation finishes completed.

The first two-response assertion incorrectly expected workspace-entry-099.txt: the native fixture marker counts toward the 100-entry cap, so 098 is the last listed file. Correcting that expectation preserves the cap rather than enlarging it.

All 27 CLI contract tests pass, including the unchanged original long-input/fork test and the new compaction-crossing case. Other than this supplemental test file, every tracked product file matches the current measured main candidate byte-for-byte. Temporary instrumentation was removed.

The earlier expanded-guidance single-response failure is consistent with the same compaction-threshold interaction, but that earlier retained draft was not rerun with this fixture here. No restored longer guidance is adopted.
